source.name: PokéAPI
source.historySemantics: Inclusive generation cutoff: select the first past entry with cutoff >= requested generation, else use current.
source.pokemonScope: One default Pokémon per species through generation IX. No alternate or regional forms.
source.availabilityNote: Generation is species introduction, not proof of local catchability, transferability, or availability in a selected game.
source.learnsetNote: Only explicit records for the selected version group. Missing entries mean no data; no fallback to another game. Groups 20 and 25 contain source DLC-era updates.
source.abilityHistoryNote: Reconstructed from sparse slot changes; source history can be incomplete. No abilities before generation III or in Let's Go; no hidden abilities before generation V. Hidden slot presence does not establish release availability.
source.abilityDescriptionNote: Descriptions use the latest available English text in a supported game, not historical battle effects.

abilities.description: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stat of all Pokémon except itself.

abilities.name: Propeller Tail
abilities.description: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

abilities.name: Mirror Armor
abilities.description: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.

abilities.name: Gulp Missile
abilities.description: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.

abilities.name: Stalwart
abilities.description: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

abilities.name: Steam Engine
abilities.description: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.

abilities.name: Punk Rock
abilities.description: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.

abilities.name: Sand Spit
abilities.description: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.

abilities.name: Ice Scales
abilities.description: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.

abilities.name: Ripen
abilities.description: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.

abilities.name: Ice Face
abilities.description: The Pokémon's ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon's appearance. The ice will be restored when it snows.

abilities.name: Power Spot
abilities.description: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.

abilities.name: Mimicry
abilities.description: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.

abilities.name: Screen Cleaner
abilities.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

abilities.name: Steely Spirit
abilities.description: Powers up the Steel-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies.

abilities.name: Perish Body
abilities.description: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.

abilities.name: Wandering Spirit
abilities.description: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.

abilities.name: Gorilla Tactics
abilities.description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.

abilities.name: Neutralizing Gas
abilities.description: If the Pokémon with Neutralizing Gas is in the battle, the effects of all Pokémon’s Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.

abilities.name: Pastel Veil
abilities.description: Protects the Pokémon and its ally Pokémon from being poisoned.

abilities.name: Hunger Switch
abilities.description: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of each turn.

abilities.name: Quick Draw
abilities.description: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.

abilities.name: Unseen Fist
abilities.description: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.

abilities.name: Curious Medicine
abilities.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

abilities.name: Transistor
abilities.description: Powers up Electric-type moves.

abilities.name: Dragon’s Maw
abilities.description: Powers up Dragon-type moves.

abilities.name: Chilling Neigh
abilities.description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

abilities.name: Grim Neigh
abilities.description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

abilities.name: As One
abilities.description: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex's Unnerve Ability and Glastrier's Chilling Neigh Ability.

abilities.name: As One
abilities.description: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex's Unnerve Ability and Spectrier's Grim Neigh Ability.

abilities.name: Lingering Aroma
abilities.description: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.

abilities.name: Seed Sower
abilities.description: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

abilities.name: Thermal Exchange
abilities.description: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

abilities.name: Anger Shell
abilities.description: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

abilities.name: Purifying Salt
abilities.description: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

abilities.name: Well-Baked Body
abilities.description: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

abilities.name: Wind Rider
abilities.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.

abilities.name: Guard Dog
abilities.description: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.

abilities.name: Rocky Payload
abilities.description: Powers up Rock-type moves.

abilities.name: Wind Power
abilities.description: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

abilities.name: Zero to Hero
abilities.description: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.

abilities.name: Commander
abilities.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.

abilities.name: Electromorphosis
abilities.description: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

abilities.name: Protosynthesis
abilities.description: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

abilities.name: Quark Drive
abilities.description: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

abilities.name: Good as Gold
abilities.description: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.

abilities.name: Vessel of Ruin
abilities.description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.

abilities.name: Sword of Ruin
abilities.description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.

abilities.name: Tablets of Ruin
abilities.description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.

abilities.name: Beads of Ruin
abilities.description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.

abilities.name: Orichalcum Pulse
abilities.description: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.

abilities.name: Hadron Engine
abilities.description: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.

abilities.name: Opportunist
abilities.description: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.

abilities.name: Cud Chew
abilities.description: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.

abilities.name: Sharpness
abilities.description: Powers up slicing moves.

abilities.name: Supreme Overlord
abilities.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

abilities.name: Costar
abilities.description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally's stat changes.

abilities.name: Toxic Debris
abilities.description: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

abilities.name: Armor Tail
abilities.description: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

abilities.name: Earth Eater
abilities.description: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

abilities.name: Mycelium Might
abilities.description: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

abilities.name: Mind’s Eye
abilities.description: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.

abilities.name: Supersweet Syrup
abilities.description: Once per battle, when a Pokémon with Supersweet Syrup enters the battle, it lowers the evasion stat of all adjacent opponents by one stage.

abilities.name: Hospitality
abilities.description: When a Pokémon with Hospitality enters a battle, it restores HP for an ally by 25%.

abilities.name: Toxic Chain
abilities.description: May cause bad poisoning when the Pokémon hits an opponent with a move.

abilities.name: Embody Aspect
abilities.description: Embody Aspect boosts a particular stat, depending on the form of a Terastallized Ogerpon

abilities.name: Tera Shift
abilities.description: When Terapagos enters the battle, it turns into its Terastal Form until the end of the battle.

abilities.name: Tera Shell
abilities.description: All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

abilities.name: Teraform Zero
abilities.description: As soon as Terapagos assumes its Stellar Form, it will immediately neutralize weather and terrain effects.

abilities.name: Poison Puppeteer
abilities.description: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.

abilities.name: Piercing Drill
abilities.description: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves.

abilities.name: Dragonize
abilities.description: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

abilities.name: Mega Sol
abilities.description: The Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

abilities.name: Spicy Spray
abilities.description: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

abilities.name: Eelevate
abilities.description: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.

abilities.name: Fire Mane
abilities.description: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.

abilities.name: Aura Guard
abilities.description: A Pokémon with Aura Guard takes half damage from moves that make contact.
